title: Lumber, strapped
story: Packages of lumber under straps on a semi-trailer.
story_pt: Pacotes de madeira serrada sob cintas numa carreta.

units.uncertain: lumber bundle; dimensions and count across width unclear

analysis.summary: A flatbed semi-trailer carries about six stacked bundles of sawn lumber secured with roughly ten top-over straps.
